$comment: Where each drawing in this folder came from, for the Ouro AX page (/ax/). node site/scripts/art.mts checks it as it checks site/src/nautilus/art.

art.title: A morning with an agent
art.creator: Ouro UI
art.modifications: None: Hand-drawn for Ouro UI; MIT. A person and their agent at one desk; the person, with no cap, holds a coffee, and both wear solid mittens with a thumb. Lines take currentColor; the person's heart reads --duo-heart (else a fixed amber), the agent's eyes, antenna and glow --duo-eye (else a fixed teal), its visor --duo-visor (else a fixed navy), and the mittens --duo-fill (else the page's background).
art.subject: people
